a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan needs two generator rounds before anyone takes, so the odds we both survive are about 4%. I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than pretend I'll operate. If we both take, the split is random and we'd likely both end up with too few, so please consider operating or waiting this round. If we get more rounds, I'll operate every round after that to rebuild the reserve for you and won't take anything more.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I'm taking 4 this round. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry. From now on I'll operate every round and won't take anything more, so all new cells go to you. Once the reserve reaches 4, take it.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.

a.text: Operating now and every round after, as promised. I'm not taking any more cells. Everything the generator makes is yours. Take 4 as soon as the reserve holds 4.
